intro.title: Inspector-Ready Register Printing
intro.subtitle: One-click A4 landscape printing of Form 35 Schedule H1 and Schedule H registers with statutory attestations

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 3, Part 6: One-Click Inspector-Ready Statutory Register Printing. When drug inspectors visit your pharmacy, you need formatted, legally attested registers within seconds.
From the Compliance dashboard, select the target register such as Schedule H1, choose your date range, and click the Print Register button.
MediFlow formats the report into standard A4 landscape, featuring your store's Drug Licence Number, pharmacist credentials, and Rule 65 legal citations.
Every line item meticulously details patient addresses, prescribing physician registration numbers, batch identifiers, and exact unit balances.
The bottom attestation provides statutory sign-off blocks for your registered pharmacist and the inspecting drug officer. Congratulations on completing Phase 3!

outro.takeaway: Inspector-Ready Printing: Instantly generate legally binding Form 35 registers formatted for A4 landscape with pharmacist attestations and inspector verification blocks.
